archive_chain_core.name: Archive chain core
archive_chain_core.purpose: Pure Dart tamper-EVIDENT SHA-256 hash chain. Hash recipe is LOCKED: sha256(jsonEncode([prevHash, ts, role, content])). Functions: computeArchiveHash (that recipe), nextEntry (builds the next link off the current tip), verifyChain (fail-closed walk reporting the FIRST break and its kind).
archive_chain_core.notes: DONE, CI-green, commit 18cbedc (per Cairn). Tamper-evident, not tamper-proof: a full recompute, tail-truncation or store-wipe needs an out-of-store backup to catch. crypto is a direct dependency. Sole recorded consumer is archive_table (#3b), which is unbuilt, so that edge is planned, not live.

crypto.name: crypto
crypto.purpose: SHA-256 hashing for the archive chain.
crypto.notes: External dependency; now a direct dependency of the app.

archive_table.name: Archive table (#3b)
archive_table.path: does not exist yet; will be a v7->v8 migration in lib/core/memory/eidetic_store_io.dart and lib/core/memory/eidetic_store_web.dart
archive_table.purpose: Dedicated append-only, single-writer archive table, hash-chained by calling archive_chain_core computeArchiveHash/nextEntry (same recipe: sha256(jsonEncode([prevHash, ts, role, content]))). Planned: DB migration v7->v8, a single chat-path writer, a fail-closed boot check. Both store implementations get it (two-impl discipline: _io device impl, _web test impl).
archive_table.notes: GREEN-LIT in v4 and being built now by Cairn (status was planned in v3; completion not confirmed). Valid regardless of rung-1. Migration v7->v8 not confirmed written. Deliberately does NOT chain the mutable episodic_log. belief_state_organ must NEVER be chained into it. The dreamer READS FROM it (planned; it is the dreamer's source, never its sink). Hash recipe resolved by Cairn: no separate concatenation exists; it reuses archive_chain_core. The uses edge is planned (applies when built).
archive_table.decision: GREEN-LIT. Being built now by Cairn. Valid regardless of the rung-1 result.

consolidation_reflection_daemon.name: Consolidation/reflection daemon (the dreamer)
consolidation_reflection_daemon.purpose: Background consolidation and reflection process. Reads FROM the archive and distills INTO the semantic store and the belief state. The archive is its SOURCE, never its sink. Known default config: consolidate.minEntries=6, reflect.everyConsolidations=3, idle.intervalMinutes=10.
consolidation_reflection_daemon.notes: HELD until rung-1 resolves; its design may shift. UNBUILT. Defaults known but nothing runs, so the live "sync interval N" is unset. CORRECTION (v4): it distills from the archive into the semantic store + belief state; the archive is never a destination. (No 'distill to archive' wording was found in v3 files; correction recorded explicitly.) Edges to archive_table (read) and belief_state_organ (write) are planned, not live; the belief-state edge also depends on rung-1 passing. The 'semantic store' is not a recorded node and its identity is not stated, so no edge is drawn to it (no inference to eidetic_memory_engine or llama_index). Location (repo/path) not stated.

belief_state_organ.name: Belief-state organ (VSA/HRR working memory)
belief_state_organ.path: not stated (own store, single BLOB; repo location not stated)
belief_state_organ.purpose: A fixed-size VSA/HRR hypervector serving as fast working memory.
validated_in_isolation: Capacity about 240 flat facts per vector
constraints: NOT yet justified: must pass the rung-1 coupling test before any production code.
Lives in its OWN store, one BLOB.
MUST NEVER be chained into the Archive.
Disposable cache, never the system of record.
Confidence floor: any decode below a cosine threshold returns UNSURE, never a guess (no-fake-data law). Threshold value not stated.
risks: Coupling unproven (the kill-shot): if the LLM does not reason better over the VSA-decoded state, the organ is abandoned.
Whitening cold-start: crosstalk is worst when memory is newest; who refits the covariance is unresolved.
Soft-failure fabrication: a bad decode can look plausible; mitigated by the confidence floor (UNSURE below threshold).
Attribution blur: superposition loses provenance, so it can only be a disposable cache.
Representation and size undecided (binary/bipolar ~1.25KB vs FHRR ~40KB).
belief_state_organ.notes: PROPOSED and UNPROVEN. Isolation results above do not establish that it helps the LLM. Fed by the LLM's embeddings (sign-quantized). The uses edge to llm_embeddings is as stated; which model or embedding source is not stated. The dreamer is expected to distill INTO it (see consolidation_reflection_daemon). Its store's repo location and lives_in are not stated, so none is recorded. No edge to the archive by design: it must never be chained into it.

rung1_coupling_test.name: Rung-1 coupling test
rung1_coupling_test.path: harness being written; runs on a GPU/Colab with a small open model
rung1_coupling_test.purpose: Gate experiment: does an LLM reason better over a VSA-decoded working state than over (b) a plain-text scratchpad or (c) RAG? If not, the organ is abandoned.
rung1_coupling_test.notes: Harness is being written; no result yet. Uses edge means it exercises the organ as the system under test. Which small open model is not stated. Baseline (c) RAG is not tied to any existing node (no edge to llama_index inferred). Outcome decides whether the organ lives and may shift the dreamer's design.

llm_embeddings.name: LLM embeddings
llm_embeddings.purpose: The LLM's embeddings, sign-quantized, as the input to the belief-state organ.
llm_embeddings.notes: Added in v4 only as the target of belief_state_organ's stated dependency, so the edge resolves. Which model, where it runs and its repo location are not stated. No relation to llama_index or the on-device target is inferred.

decisions.decision: #3b durable archive store (archive_table) is GREEN-LIT and being built now by Cairn; valid regardless of rung-1.
The dreamer (consolidation_reflection_daemon) is HELD until rung-1 resolves; its design may shift.
Confidence floor: any belief-state decode below a cosine threshold returns UNSURE, never a guess (no-fake-data law). Threshold value not set.
belief_state_organ lives in its own store (one BLOB), is never chained into the Archive, and is a disposable cache, not a system of record.
No production code for belief_state_organ until rung1_coupling_test passes.
